verdict.rationale: The desktop app can install and run MCP connectors that live on your machine, which is a route to local tool execution. It also has a desktop terminal with multiple sessions, and offers a guided wizard for connecting a local Agent. None of these items explicitly says the assistant itself runs shell commands or edits local files; they point to an exec surface rather than documenting one. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of agent-driven command execution, built-in file read/write/edit tools, permission or approval controls, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
